heroSummary: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year on Tuesday, July 27, 2027, and lists Thursday, May 25, 2028, as the last day for students. The family calendar includes 180 student days, one-hour early releases, K-12 half days, K-6 parent-teacher conference half days, semester half days, and a June 5–30 summer school window.
calendarNotes: The GPS family calendar separates one-hour early releases from K-12 half days, K-6 conference half days, semester half days, grading days, and summer school.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Gilbert Public Schools start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Gilbert Public Schools starts the 2027–28 school year on Tuesday, July 27, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Gilbert Public Schools fall break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall break runs from Monday, October 4, through Friday, October 15, 2027. Students return Monday, October 18.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the downloaded Gilbert calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar file is a one-time import and does not automatically reflect later Gilbert Public Schools revisions.
